title: Automated Experimental Diffraction Pattern Indexing in pyEMAPS
content: The python package, pyEMAPS, aims to accelerate research and education in electron diffraction and microscopy and to bridge the gap between crystallography, electron diffraction theory, and electron microscopy practices (Fig. 1). Many of its features are freely available, such as kinematic and dynamic diffraction simulations implemented based on kinematical and dynamical electron diffraction theories described by Spence and Zuo in the book "Electron Microdiffraction" [1]. Simulating large diffraction datasets can also greatly speedup research with data-driven electron microscopy. Several solutions have been developed to meet the needs of large datasets and utilizing machine learning techniques for electron diffraction simulations as in 4D-STEM.
